caption: The drawing depicts four distinct ornamental metal objects, each triangular in shape with elaborate designs, arranged in two rows and two columns against a beige background. The objects are predominantly gold in color, with darker brown and reddish-brown shading used to accentuate depth and detail. Each object features a symmetrical composition with a central vertical division and intricate engraved or pierced patterns, some incorporating swirls and leaf-like motifs. The upper left object is topped with a multi-tiered finial and has a border decorated with dots. The upper right object features a stylized bird’s head with a beak, circular eye, and ornate curling scrollwork along the sides. The lower left piece also has scrolling side decorations, with a rounded central top opening and a design that mirrors some elements of the object above it. The lower right object is characterized by a series of oval cut-outs and decorative engraving, topped by a pointed, tiered element. All four objects have a reddish-brown shadow effect around their borders, which visually lifts them off the background.
title: Patch Boxes of Kentucky Rifles
